Open developer portal
The SOTA approval checkpoint

A decision model your agent can branch on.

Forsig returns a structured response: approved, rejected, edited, takeover, more context, or timeout.

Approve

Proceed with the proposed action.

Edit

Continue with safer reviewer instructions.

Reject

Stop the risky action before damage.

Take over

Move the task to a human operator.

More context

Ask the agent to gather missing details.

Timeout

Fail closed when nobody responds.

Developers

Wrap a risky action with a Forsig checkpoint.

Install the SDK, send minimal review context, and wait for the signed decision your agent can branch on.

import { Forsig } from "@forsig/sdk";

const forsig = new Forsig({ apiKey: process.env.FORSIG_API_KEY });

const decision = await forsig.escalate({
  agent: "refund-agent",
  action: "stripe.refund",
  risk: "refund_over_limit",
  context: { amount: 500, customer: "VIP customer #123" },
  waitForDecision: true
});

if (decision.status === "approved") {
  await issueRefund();
}
